ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black/dark grey pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and along linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes. Dark low-intensity mapping includes continuous banding along the trailing edges and multiple thin, radiating linear streaks from the fluke base. A distinct dark focal spot is located at the upper mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box offset.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe interior edge shows significantly sharper and more numerous pixel peaks compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the leading and outer lateral edges of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast textured pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surface, primarily in vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips and significant linear scarring/rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark circular pixel cluster located on the white background in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.
